ESPN injury page: 800 listings (219 not fully active).
Model weights from backtest 2015-2026: 22% spreads, 5% totals.
Factor groups left out because the backtest found they hurt: scoring_env, time_of_day.
DraftKings lines from ESPN's scoreboard (model refresh between Odds API runs).
Bet timing uses research defaults until backtest.py has opening-line history to learn from.
